headline: Natural Language Turns Journeys Into Tests
lede: e2e gives QA teams a procedural way to describe user journeys while an agent operates the application. Recorded actions can replay without fresh model calls, pairing flexible exploration with deterministic assertions across browsers and mobile devices.

headline: Claude-Mem Gives Coding Agents A Past
lede: Claude-Mem builds a retrieval stream for work that normally disappears when a session ends. SQLite storage, hybrid search, timelines, and progressive disclosure let agents recover the right project history without flooding the next prompt.

headline: Text-to-CAD Moves Ideas Toward Fabrication
lede: Text-to-CAD turns a conversational brief into a manufacturable 3D workflow, from model generation to design checks and export. Its local runtime, browser viewer, and fabrication-oriented skills map a clear path from prompt to STEP, STL, or GLB.

headline: T3 Code Puts Coding Agents On Call
lede: T3 Code is a practical control surface for agents already installed on a developer’s machines. Its launcher, background service, and mobile-ready interface make remote sessions manageable without replacing the underlying tools or provider accounts.

headline: AnyPS5 Rebuilds A Path Beyond The Console
lede: AnyPS5 attacks platform boundaries at the executable and system-library level, relinking PlayStation 5 software for Linux and Windows. A shader recompiler, native integration, and explicit unsupported-state errors make the project a serious compatibility study rather than a black-box emulator.

headline: Agent-Reach Routes The Open Web Locally
lede: Agent-Reach gives agents a local capability layer for retrieving data across services without requiring a separate official API for every destination. Primary-and-fallback routing improves resilience, while local credential storage and auditable backends keep the access path visible.

headline: OpenMontage Turns Agents Into A Film Crew
lede: OpenMontage treats video production as a workshop of repeatable pipelines, tools, and skill files. Its Backlot dashboard tracks research, assets, budgets, and validation while agents assemble everything from scripts to finished cinematic sequences.

headline: Caddy Makes HTTPS The Starting Point
lede: Caddy is a production web server that handles modern HTTP traffic, certificate renewal, and configuration changes with unusually little ceremony. Its Go module system and JSON API give operators a reliable core that can scale from a small reverse proxy to clustered deployments.

headline: openGym Keeps Every Set In Reach
lede: openGym brings workout planning, recovery analysis, progression rules, and long-term data ownership into one self-hosted system. Its import and export tools, offline-capable clients, and passkey support make the training record portable instead of subscription-bound.

headline: Cloudflare OS Reimagines The Internal Tool
lede: Cloudflare OS presents enterprise software as a collection of small, AI-created Gadgets rather than fixed SaaS applications. Gatekeepers, sandboxing, and human approval flows give that fluid interface a controlled route into external services.
